text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position and repeated reasons","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its claim directly and keeps returning to the same anti-driverless-car position throughout."},{"evidence":"explanation of alerts, lane changes, potholes, and children crossing","quality":"specific supporting detail","description":"It uses more concrete examples to show how driverless cars could fail in everyday road situations."},{"evidence":"driver could fall asleep or get distracted","quality":"cause-and-effect reasoning","description":"It develops a plausible chain of consequences from driverless-car use to reduced attention and greater risk."},{"evidence":"paragraphs built around separate objections","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"The essay groups its points into distinct body paragraphs that each focus on a different concern."},{"evidence":"opening claim and closing question about safety","quality":"essay structure","description":"It has a more recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion than the comparison essay."}]}
